_comment: Seed template for factory_flash.py --config. Copy it, edit it, then flash: factory_flash.py -p /dev/ttyUSB0 --config my-seed.json. Every key is optional and the values below are the firmware defaults, so flashing this file unchanged behaves like flashing without --config (the board still boots into first-time setup). Keys beginning with "_" are ignored, so your copy can carry notes. See the factory_flash.py header for per-key limits.
